svg.title: Centrair — Central Japan International Airport Station
svg.desc: English flat-plan accessibility map for Meitetsu Central Japan International Airport Station NH36. The gates are on the right and platforms extend to the left. Platform 1 is for μSKY; platforms 2 and 3 serve other trains toward Kanayama and Meitetsu Nagoya. Accessible toilets and lockers inside the gates are shown, together with airport connections from Access Plaza.

g.text: Central Japan International Airport / NH36 • Meitetsu Airport Line
Same-level route • toilets • lockers • airport connections
Gates at right • platforms extend left • all routes inside the station are flat
The station gate, concourse and platforms are on the same level. No stairs, escalators or elevators are needed inside the station.
All station toilets shown include wheelchair-accessible facilities. Access Plaza facilities are outside the ticket gates. Schematic / not to scale.
